params.caption: Instrumental Chinese folk-orchestral video game background music for a peaceful Jiangnan water town on a fresh, clear morning after rain. A bright bamboo flute (dizi) sings a gentle pentatonic melody over flowing guzheng arpeggios, light pipa plucks and a soft, warm string ensemble. Light woodblock and hand percussion keep an easy walking pulse. Airy, clean and unhurried with even dynamics. No vocals, no drum kit, no synthesizer.
